thread:
Eva: Quick decision needed — Optimize toolkit sequencing: quantization, batching, caching. AcmeCorp pilot is asking; they need a predictable 20–30% cost cut for early rollout. Can we decide order and owners by EOD?

Matt: Quick Q — do we assume batching requires infra changes (autoscaling + queue) or just runtime changes?

Sophie: Short RICE sketch, trying to be pragmatic:
```
Quantization  - Reach: 40, Impact: 8, Confidence: 70, Effort: 3  => score ~746
Batching       - Reach: 30, Impact: 6, Confidence: 80, Effort: 2  => score ~720
Caching        - Reach: 20, Impact: 4, Confidence: 60, Effort: 1  => score ~480
```
Numbers rough but shows quant and batch compete; caching has lower reach but tiny effort.

Rahul: infra note — caching needs coordination with routing and eviction logic, plus KV-store capacity planning. If we treat caching as a lightweight feature (~1 sprint) we should still blast a separate infra spike to validate ops concerns.

Jen: UX/ops concern — we need clear rollout toggles and per-customer telemetry before enabling caching for enterprise customers. That adds a bit of scope.

Matt: For batching: if we do conservative continuous batching (no large queuing), effort is low and latency hit small. But batching gains depend on request shape (short vs long ctx). We should add a workload sample check in the plan.

Sophie: Proposal for launch criteria (MVP):
- Quantization: 8-bit/4-bit path implemented, end-to-end eval against prompt suite, <=2% quality regression, >=10% per-token cost reduction in staging.
- Batching: Continuous batching enabled, 95th p95 latency within SLO for 95% of traces, >=8% cost reduction on traffic mix.
- Caching: Prefix KV cache MVP behind feature flag, validated for correctness on 3 workloads, ops toggle + telemetry.

Eva: Decision proposal — prioritize: 1) Quantization (owner: Sophie) 2) Batching (owner: Matt) 3) Caching as a parallel infra spike (owner: Rahul) so we don't block delivery. Keep Jen on gating/rollout criteria. Can we all ack? :thumbsup:

Matt: Ack. I'll scope a 3-week sprint for batching + one PR for conservative batching strategy.

Sophie: Ack. Start with quant profiles and small-quant eval harness. I'll post model checklist by EOD.

Rahul: Ack. I'll open an infra spike ticket for caching ops and run a small perf matrix against current routing.

Jen: Ack. I'll draft rollout checklist + telemetry dashboard queries.

Eva: Great — owners + EOD deliverables: Sophie posts model checklist, Matt posts batching workload sample, Rahul opens spike ticket, Jen draft rollout gating. We'll reconvene in 48h if blockers.

prio-bot: Decision logged: Optimize-toolkit sequencing set to Quantization -> Batching, with parallel Caching infra spike. Owners: Sophie, Matt, Rahul.

Eva: Thanks all — short, focused runbook next. :)
